positions.title: Senior Software Architect and Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the entire lifecycle of our software products, from conception to packaging, working with Development (as well as developing a large parts of the code itself), QA, Deployment, and Customer Support teams to help provide a complete product experience for our customers.

Responsible for architecture and standards compliance, and guidance and decisions on future emerging technology use in our products.  Often looked at new ways to incorporate our software into other products.

Standardized our software development process, including the use of bug tracking software, automated build and testing software, in order to produce consistent software results.  Worked with our Linux engineers to create a virtual appliance for software deployment.

positions.title: Lead Java Software Engineer
positions.description: Rebuilt the existing C++/.NET application in Java to provide Linux support.  Continued to support and improve product, including a better administrative experience, as well as implementing many software automation tools, such as Jira, Bamboo and Selenium to provide a consistent build and test framework,

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continued working and creating new solutions with IM and publish-subscribe technology.  One of these technologies, SkillTap,  used these technologies  to connect to and chat with people within the company with very specialized knowledge. 
I was then transferred to the Sametime group to continue work on the development of the publish-subscribe system, testing, and deployment of the Sametime client within the company.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on various projects, most notably a new internal Sametime IM client, which was later incorporated into the product.
Also patented several technologies concerning publish-subscribe systems and interactive “chat bots”, which I helped create for use within the company.  Most of these bots were used to query information, such as the internal IBM employee directory.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: As a Windows Server specialist,   I worked on several external contracts to deliver IBM solutions and maintain and upgrade Windows Servers.

patents.title: Querying a dynamic database with an electronic message directed to subscribers of a publish/subscribe computer service
patents.description: A message received from a user causes a query of a dynamic database such as a FAQ or Relational Database, the results of the query are returned to the user. Furthermore the received message is published to a community of anonymous users. Optionally the user can edit the returned results and store the edited version in the dynamic database or edit the dynamic database via a GUI interface.

patents.title: Just-in-time publishing via a publish/subscribe messaging system having message publishing controls
patents.description: A system and program product having at least one subscriber subscribing to topics from one or more data sources. The number of subscriptions for each data source are registered in a table in real time. Upon detecting subscription activity, a matching routine compares the number of subscriptions registered for the available data source with a predetermined value, and if the number of subscribers exceeds the predetermined value a data source process corresponding to the data source will be started, and messages from the data source will be sent to the data source subscriber/s, otherwise, the data source provider will be stopped and not longer send messages.
